title: Integral test
text: Use the integral of $$\frac{1}{x \ln\left(x\right)}$$ from $$2$$ to $$\infty$$. Substitute $$u=ln(x)$$.

title: Antiderivative
text: An antiderivative of $$\frac{1}{x \ln\left(x\right)}$$ is ln(ln(x)). What is its value at $$x=e^e$$?

title: Conclusion
text: ln(ln(x)) grows without bound as $$x$$ goes to $$\infty$$, so the integral diverges.
